payload.title: Letter swap
payload.description: A letter-by-letter hover interaction. Each character rolls into its next position, with adjustable direction, timing, and stagger.
payload.attribution: Daniel Petho, Fancy Components. MIT. Community-listed example, not a submission or endorsement by the maintainer.

payload.title: Scramble hover
payload.description: A hover-triggered text scramble that resolves back to your original words. Tune the character set, sequence, and reveal direction.
payload.attribution: Daniel Petho, Fancy Components. MIT. Community-listed example, not a submission or endorsement by the maintainer.

payload.title: Passing underline
payload.description: An underline that travels across a word instead of switching on. A small interaction for links, navigation, and expressive typography.
payload.attribution: Daniel Petho, Fancy Components. MIT. Community-listed example, not a submission or endorsement by the maintainer.

payload.title: Typewriter
payload.description: Text that types, pauses, and deletes. Supports multiple phrases, custom cursors, and configurable timing.
payload.attribution: Daniel Petho, Fancy Components. MIT. Community-listed example, not a submission or endorsement by the maintainer.
